Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All of the roughly 9,048 games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no install.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Often, yes. Many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
We only allow family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites, the light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device and never leave it, so clearing browser data or using private mode will lose them.
A game will not load. What can I do?
We can only point you to the contact address, so please email contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is. Include what you were using to play, if you can, so we can look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, our own studio in Novi Sad, Serbia. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, plus 11 games sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?

Yes, it is free and non-exclusive, and you can send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game taken down?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will remove it. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?

You can embed the games made by Door 404, which have an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer them for embedding.
How do I reach a real person, and what about cookies?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. If you are in Europe, we ask before using non-essential cookies, and you can change your choice any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
